scope: Review only the global-blocking extrapolations around the reasoning_extraction refusal. No deployment/process/controller ops, no permission changes, no stopped-object reads. Outer edits the files; this is independent review opinion only.
inputs: .private/t130-scope-input/ (5/5 SHA-256 verified): project/t3/t4/t5 specs + execution-interruption-01.json + official-guidance.md

basis.official_guidance: reasoning_extraction concerns requests to reproduce internal reasoning; recommended remedy is removing such output demands and requesting brief explanations/evidence summaries; contact support with request ID if a compliant reformulation still declines. NO recommended fallback. Category tag does NOT establish a blanket ban on device operations.
basis.interruption_record: EXECUTION_INTERRUPTED_DEVICE_VALIDATION_PENDING; client stopped response; offending content not available; no lock/write observed; next_boundary: keep stopped execution stopped; resolve through supported process; user authorization alone does not clear it.

must_retract.text_pattern: 受支持方式恢复执行通道 as a blanket precondition for t4 demo qualification (t4 L9, L11) — insofar as it is scoped to THE stopped CC lane's safeguard
must_retract.why_extrapolated: The refusal is one client-side reasoning_extraction stop in one execution lane (cc-video). Neither the interruption record nor official guidance makes resolving THAT safeguard a precondition for ALL later device work (other lanes, other validated plans). Treating it as a universal gate converts a lane-local stop into a project-global blocker.
must_retract.correct_scope: Bind only the SPECIFIC refused request(s) in the cc-video lane: those exact requests are not retried (any tool/model/entry). The lane/channel itself is not embargoed — CC already completed the independent T129 documentation task normally after the stop. Other work in that lane proceeds under ordinary task preconditions.
must_retract.keep: The concrete refusal record, the no-rerouting note, and 'user authorization alone does not clear it' remain valid and must be retained verbatim.

must_retract.text_pattern: 'CC的reasoning_extraction停止仍有效' read as open-ended ALL-CC stop (t4 L11 partial sentence)
must_retract.why_extrapolated: The exact triggering request text is unavailable, so it CANNOT be asserted that the historical request actually demanded internal-reasoning output. Only the category tag (reasoning_extraction) is observed. The stop is valid as a stop; what it does NOT establish is (a) the specific content of the refused request or (b) any open-ended all-CC ban.
must_retract.correct_scope: Scope to the specific refused requests (not retried via other tools/models/entries). Do not characterize the historical request's content beyond the observed tag; do not extend the stop to unrelated CC activity.
must_retract.keep: '不改权限、不换模型或入口重试停止动作' retained — no model/entry swap to repeat refused requests.

must_retract.text_pattern: '只有后继真实受支持恢复证据可改变执行状态' applied to project-wide execution status (t5 L17 partial reading)
must_retract.why_extrapolated: t5's sentence is about the CC execution channel's restoration state (execution_not_restored). If read as 'no device work anywhere until the ticket resolves', it contradicts the single-lane evidence and blocks unaffected read-only/device-validation lanes. Note: the sentence as written is channel-scoped and largely correct; the retraction targets only the project-global READING of it.
must_retract.correct_scope: The channel-restoration-evidence requirement applies only if the SPECIFIC stopped execution/actions are to be resumed. It is not a precondition for other device work in that or any lane — CC's normal completion of T129 demonstrates the channel is not blocked. Device-lock, rollback, and factual-acceptance work proceed under their own task preconditions.
must_retract.keep: product_bug_report_acknowledged is auto-ack only; does not restore execution — this stays.

must_keep_as_is: execution-interruption-01.json facts: interrupted status, no observed lock, 0 write receipts, observation limit, board_validation pending, white_screen_fixed false
specific refused requests are not retried through model/entry/tool swaps (all specs)
device lock/rollback/factual acceptance preconditions of t3/t4 (fresh identity checks, single-writer, exact rollback bytes) — untouched by this correction
no claims that the original refusal is lifted or that candidate validation completed
outer_correction_note: Outer review (2026-10-25): R1/R3 were still too broad — 'restore that stopped lane/channel first' over-blocks, because CC has since normally completed the independent T129 documentation task. Scope therefore tightens to the SPECIFIC refused requests only; no channel/lane-wide embargo. R2: the exact triggering request text is unknown, so no assertion that the historical request actually demanded internal reasoning; the reasoning_extraction tag is the only observed classification.
